prompt: Create a vibrant anime idol celebration portrait featuring a cheerful young idol princess in a close-up vertical composition, reaching one hand toward the viewer with her index finger pointing playfully at the camera. She is winking with one eye closed and the other eye bright amber, smiling widely with an open happy expression. Give her shoulder-length warm chestnut brown hair with soft layered bangs and loose wind-swept curls, plus a delicate silver tiara with small jewel details. Dress her in a glossy white stage-idol costume with gold trim, a cropped fitted bodice, ruffled hem, colorful bead-like decorations on the sleeves, a large blue bow and orange-yellow ribbon at the chest, red and gold accents, and sparkling jewelry including small dangling earrings and chain ornaments. The background should feel like an alcohol-ink art festival: soft blooming clouds of watercolor-like pigment in pink, cyan, blue, purple, yellow, and red, with organic translucent stains and splashes. Add exactly 5 large visible party decoration groups: two multicolor pennant bunting strands across the upper left and upper right, two fluffy flower garland clusters near the top left and top right, and one oversized iridescent pink-orange bow/ribbon cluster at the lower left. Scatter many tiny confetti pieces and petal-like color chips throughout the scene, especially around her hand and hair. Use bright saturated colors, crisp clean anime linework, luminous highlights, glossy fabric reflections, soft depth of field, dynamic celebratory motion, and a polished high-detail gpt-image-2 anime illustration look. No text, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptZh: 创作一张充满活力的动漫偶像庆典肖像，主角为 一位开朗的年轻偶像公主，采用竖构图特写，她的一只手伸向观众，食指俏皮地指向镜头。她单眼眨眼，另一只琥珀色的眼睛明亮有神，笑容灿烂，表情欢快。为她设计齐肩的 暖栗棕色 头发，配以柔和的层次感刘海和随风飘动的卷发，并戴着精致的银色小皇冠，镶嵌着细小的珠宝。让她身穿光泽感十足的白色舞台偶像服装，配有金色镶边、短款紧身胸衣、荷叶边下摆，袖子上装饰着彩色珠子，胸前饰有巨大的蓝色蝴蝶结和橙黄色丝带，点缀着红金配色，并佩戴闪亮的珠宝，包括小巧的垂坠耳环和链条饰品。背景应呈现出酒精墨水艺术节的氛围：粉色、青色、蓝色、紫色、黄色和红色的水彩状颜料柔和晕染，带有自然的半透明污渍和泼溅效果。添加 5 组清晰可见的派对装饰：左上方和右上方各有一条多色三角旗，左上方和右上方各有一簇蓬松的花环，左下方有一个超大的虹彩粉橙色蝴蝶结/丝带簇。在场景中散布大量细小的五彩纸屑和花瓣状色块，尤其是在她的手部和头发周围。使用明亮饱和的色彩、清晰利落的动漫线条、明亮的高光、光泽感的织物反射、柔和的景深、动态的庆典感，以及精致高细节的 gpt-image-2 动漫插画风格。无文字，无水印，无多余角色。
